component.name: Furinar
component.summary: A light, fast, and beautiful audio player

description.p: Furinar is a lightweight audio player inspired by the Hydro Archon. It opens in milliseconds and uses only 2–10 MB of RAM while covering everything a real player needs: tags, synced lyrics, multiple libraries, and native system integration.

ul.li: MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG/Vorbis, and M4A support

screenshot.caption: Immersive mode with the library drawer
Identifying a track and fetching lyrics from the web

description.p: Scanning folders with MKV/WebM videos no longer freezes the window (probe results are cached). Seeking MP4 videos without ffmpeg no longer stalls the audio. Sound-based identification (AcoustID) now works for videos.
Video-only view in the immersive mode (V key): no text, controls or dimming over the video. Video tracks get their own icon in the track lists. Fixed the duration and seeking of MP4 files with video.

Videos play as tracks: MP4/MOV/M4V natively, MKV/WebM/AVI through the system ffmpeg. The normal window plays only the audio; in the immersive mode the video itself becomes the background, in sync with the music.
The Discord status shows the album cover of the current track instead of the Furinar logo (from the MusicBrainz match, or looked up on Deezer).

Windows installer (per user, no admin rights). Reliable updates: a new update notice with release notes, download progress and a "Restart now" button; every download is verified against the release checksums. The Linux install script now installs per user and keeps Furinar up to date. Fixes the settings card overflowing in English, with new language and theme selectors.
Fixes an occasional crash (segmentation fault) on Linux while playing, searching the web or after a few minutes of use.

Immersive fullscreen mode with custom and animated backgrounds, visualizer, karaoke-style lyrics and an album grid. Gapless playback, crossfade and ReplayGain. Favorites, most played and per-tab sorting. Track identification and lyrics from the web (MusicBrainz, AcoustID, LRCLIB). Discord status, ListenBrainz and Last.fm scrobbling, and a mini player.
